requirements.title: Note-Taking Application
requirements.description: An application designed for users to create, manage, and organize notes efficiently.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create and save text-based notes.

features.name: Edit Notes
features.description: Enables users to modify existing notes.

features.name: Delete Notes
features.description: Provides functionality to delete notes that are no longer needed.

features.name: Organize Notes
features.description: Allows users to categorize or tag notes for better organization.

requirements.target_users: Individuals looking for a simple tool to manage their notes.
requirements.data_requirements: Requires storage for saving and retrieving user notes.

tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
实现笔记的 CRUD API
创建笔记管理前端页面
实现笔记的组织功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with tables for notes, including fields like title, content, timestamps, and optional tags or categories.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for efficient querying and consider scalability for large datasets.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes using a backend framework like Django or Express.js.
T2.notes: Implement input validation and error handling for robust functionality.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end interface using a framework like React or Vue.js to allow users to view, create, edit, and delete notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and integrate the CRUD API for seamless functionality.

T4.implementation_approach: Add features to organize notes by categories, tags, or folders, and implement sorting and filtering options in both the backend and frontend.
T4.notes: Consider using a tagging system or hierarchical folder structure for better organization.

Implement CRUD API routes for managing notes: POST /notes, GET /notes, PUT /notes/{id}, DELETE /notes/{id}.
Initialize the Flask app, register blueprints, and configure the database connection.
Entry point for the Flask application.
Create the frontend page for managing notes, including displaying, creating, editing, and deleting notes.
Provide styling for the notes management frontend page.
Add a 'category' field to the Note model to support note organization by category.
Update API routes to support filtering notes by category using GET /notes?category=.
Update the frontend page to support displaying and filtering notes by category.
